summary: Brindlewythe client readout (26 January 2026) for BW25_0600, Avernelwick Pharmaceuticals Ltd: primary potency on 24 reserve compounds from the AP02 hinge-binder screening set and a 16-kinase selectivity sweep at 1 µM on six of them. AP02-01430 was selected by Avernelwick for the next chemistry round (one off-target kinase above 50%, more potent than AP02-01410, the other one-hit compound); AP02-01418 and AP02-01428 were set aside for broad off-target inhibition.
